contact.message: Want your own website? Email me what you need and I will get back to you.
contact.info:
Your Own Website for $20, Live on GitHub
I'll build a clean, mobile-friendly website and publish it for you on GitHub Pages. No monthly hosting fees, no hidden costs. You get a live link you can share right away, plus the full files.

A couple of things worth stating in the description so customers aren't surprised:

The link format: it will look like yourname.github.io/sitename, not a .com.
Who owns the GitHub account: whether you host it on your account or transfer it to theirs.
Edits: how many revisions are included.
contact.payment:
Description: Website Purchase
Amount: $20.00 USD
Includes: Complete website files (HTML/CSS/JS), one-time delivery via download link or email, and basic setup instructions.
Terms: Payment is due in full before delivery. Digital products are non-refundable once delivered.
